## Continuum 0.5.7

**Phone screenshots → PC clipboard, on every major Android brand**
- **Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO** save screenshots as JPEG. The computer now turns them into PNG, so Ctrl+V works in every app, including browsers and chat apps that only accept PNG.
- **Screenshots are recognised by folder or by file name** (`Screenshot_…`). This covers Pixel, Motorola and Huawei (Pictures/Screenshots), Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, OPPO and realme (DCIM/Screenshots), and older vivo phones (Screenshots/).
- **Very large screenshots** (a busy screen on a 1440p phone like the Galaxy Ultra) are sent as a sharp JPEG instead of being skipped, then become a PNG on the computer.

Tested end to end with each maker's way of saving screenshots.

Update the phone app from inside Continuum (Settings → Check for updates). The computer updates with your normal system updates (Software, `sudo apt upgrade`, `sudo dnf upgrade`, `sudo pacman -Syu`).
